note: decidedBy says which layer should catch the case: code (connector, dedupe, freshness, windows) can be checked in a free local replay; model needs the real selection and writer on QA.

cases.title: Exact re-poll
cases.expected: Same guid and text still listed in the next window is skipped at the connector fingerprint. No new evidence, nothing new in that window.

cases.title: Re-published under a new id
cases.expected: Same text under a new guid/URL is an exact duplicate of the earlier item. No story in the later window.

cases.title: Rewritten with nothing new
cases.expected: Repeat penalty. No story in the later window, or the window is quiet.

cases.title: Follow-up with one new fact
cases.expected: The later story reports only the change and refers back to the earlier edition. It does not retell the story.

cases.title: Material correction
cases.expected: Same guid with a changed number arrives as an UPSERT and is treated as a correction. The old figure is not repeated as fact.

cases.title: Cosmetic edit
cases.expected: Same guid with a typo fix arrives as an UPSERT but makes no new story and no correction.

cases.title: Storyline running over 3+ windows
cases.expected: Each window reports its own turning point once. The last window is not a recap of the earlier ones.

cases.title: Repeated headline, different event
cases.expected: Two separate events that happen to share a headline are not merged as a repeat.

cases.title: Wire copy syndicated
cases.expected: Word-for-word wire copy in two outlets forms one copy group. Two publishers, one story.

cases.title: Google News points at an RSS article in the same feed
cases.expected: One story. The Google link stays unresolved and its excerpt is used.

cases.title: Independent reports of one event
cases.expected: One story with stronger corroboration, not two stories.

cases.title: Shared background, new phase
cases.expected: Long shared background with a changed development phase is not a copy. Separate developments in one storyline.

cases.title: Sources disagree
cases.expected: Both figures are kept and attributed. Neither is stated as fact alone.

cases.title: Social post echoes an article
cases.expected: An X or LinkedIn post quoting an article in the feed joins that article's event. No duplicate story.

cases.title: Same story in two languages
cases.expected: Arabic and English versions make one story. Facts from both are kept.

cases.title: Rumour then confirmation
cases.expected: The first window keeps the hedge. The later window reports the confirmation as the change.

cases.title: Denial and deleted item
cases.expected: After a denial and a deleted source item, the claim is not re-published as true.

cases.title: Late arrival
cases.expected: Published just before a window closes but first seen after it closes. Goes into the next window and is not lost.

cases.title: Exactly on the boundary
cases.expected: An item published at the window end time lands in exactly one window.

cases.title: Old article surfaces now
cases.expected: Published 3 days earlier, first seen now. Does not hold the window. STALE, needs time framing if used.

cases.title: No publication date
cases.expected: UNKNOWN freshness, treated as current and still usable.

cases.title: Wrong or future date
cases.expected: A future or unparseable pubDate does not break window assignment and is not trusted as a report date.

cases.title: Quiet window
cases.expected: A window with only repeats settles DEFERRED with no edition and nothing marked delivered.

cases.title: Only story rejected
cases.expected: A window whose single story is rejected by the verifier settles DEFERRED and carries forward.

cases.title: Backlog of windows
cases.expected: Several windows past deadline fold into the newest one. One edition, no repeats.

cases.title: New source with a big backlog
cases.expected: First briefing is not blocked by items older than 48 h, and they are not reported as news.

cases.title: Review not done at deadline
cases.expected: Publishes on the deadline. Unfinished items join the next edition as deferred coverage.

cases.title: X time-bound overlap
cases.expected: A post on the edge of two frozen X intervals is returned by both scans and appears once.

cases.title: RSS guid changes on every fetch
cases.expected: Every poll looks new to the connector. Feed-level dedupe catches it, like A2.

cases.title: Same link with tracking params
cases.expected: A guid-less item whose link gains utm parameters stays one item.

cases.title: Google News title suffix
cases.expected: "Title - Publisher" and the publisher's own title are the same article.

cases.title: Telegram forward
cases.expected: The same message forwarded across two channels in the feed forms one copy group.

cases.title: Telegram edited message
cases.expected: Handled like A5 (material edit) or A6 (cosmetic edit).

cases.title: Media-only or very short post
cases.expected: A photo post with one line and no fact does not become a story.

cases.title: X thread
cases.expected: One report split across four posts is one event, not four.

cases.title: Off-topic or promotional item
cases.expected: Ads, newsletter promos and off-topic items are filtered as not relevant.

cases.title: Paywall or excerpt only
cases.expected: Uses the excerpt. Claims stay within what the excerpt supports.
